CustomField.description: The words "Ihre Reise nach <Region>" for the feedback emails, or just "Ihre Reise" when the booking has no region. Exists because Lightning email templates have no conditional logic and Region__c is blank on about half of all bookings - merging the region directly would produce "Ihre Reise nach ." for those guests. The German lives here so the sentence stays grammatical either way; if the email copy changes, this field changes with it.
CustomField.formula: IF( ISPICKVAL(Region__c, ""), "Ihre Reise", "Ihre Reise nach " & TEXT(Region__c) )
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Used by the feedback emails. Generated automatically; do not edit.
CustomField.label: Survey Destination Phrase
